request.prompt:
A full-body or three-quarter reference image of Alex Phantum, age 17, in Keel work surroundings. He should be shown as a lean, mechanically capable young worker whose clothing and carried objects can be kept consistent across the book.

Must be shown, exactly as written: No scars or other distinguishing physical marks are established. Do not add a signature scar, tattoo, prosthesis, or other fixed mark. `(characters.md)`

Not established, so your choice: The image may show Alex with one hand on an aging pump or holding the casino chip, because both are established objects and behaviours, but it need not depict a story event.

Must not appear: Do not make the casino chip technologically luminous or give Alex scars or other distinguishing marks not established in the files.

No lettering of any kind: no captions, labels, signage, logos, numbers, speech balloons or on-screen text, unless the brief requires a specific one. Concept reference, not finished comic art; no panel borders.

Add nothing that tells a story of its own: no invented symbols, emblems, documents or events. Render the description, not an interpretation of it.
